translations.idiomatic: Following the Spring and Autumn format, from after the Capture of the Lin stag through Qin and Han down to Later Wei he authored a chronicle book called the Original Classic.

sentences.zh: 又依《孔子家語》、揚雄《法言》例，為客主對答之說，號曰《中說》。

translations.literal: Also following the examples of Confucius's Family Talk and Yang Xiong's Exemplary Sayings, he made guest-and-host dialogues called the Central Sayings.
translations.idiomatic: Also following the examples of Confucius's Family Talk and Yang Xiong's Exemplary Sayings, he made guest-and-host dialogues called the Central Sayings.

sentences.zh: 皆為儒士所稱。

translations.literal: Both were praised by Confucian scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Both were praised by Confucian scholars.

sentences.zh: 義寧元年卒，門人薛收等相與議謚曰文中子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yining he died; his disciples Xue Shou and others together discussed and gave the posthumous title Master of Letters in the Wen tradition.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yining he died; his disciples Xue Shou and others together discussed and gave the posthumous title Master of Letters in the Wen tradition.

sentences.zh: 二子：福畤、福郊。

translations.literal: Two sons: Fuchao and Fujiao.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons: Fuchao and Fujiao.

sentences.zh: 勃六歲解屬文，構思無滯，詞情英邁，與兄勔、勮，才藻相類。

translations.literal: Bo at six sui could compose linked text, forming ideas without delay; his language was spirited and bold—like his elder brothers Mian and Xun in literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: Bo at six sui could compose linked text, forming ideas without delay; his language was spirited and bold—like his elder brothers Mian and Xun in literary talent.

sentences.zh: 父友杜易簡常稱之曰：「此王氏三珠樹也。」

translations.literal: Father's friend Du Yijian often praised them saying: "These are the three pearl trees of the Wang clan."
translations.idiomatic: Father's friend Du Yijian often praised them saying, "These are the three pearl trees of the Wang clan."

sentences.zh: 勃年未及冠，應幽素舉及第。

translations.literal: Bo before capped years passed the Yousu recommendation and succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Bo before capped years passed the Yousu recommendation and succeeded.

sentences.zh: 乾封初，詣闕上《宸遊東嶽頌》。

translations.literal: In the early Qianfeng era he went to the gate and submitted the Eulogy on the Imperial Tour of the Eastern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianfeng era he went to the gate and submitted the Eulogy on the Imperial Tour of the Eastern Peak.

sentences.zh: 時東都造乾元殿，又上《乾元殿頌》。

translations.literal: At the time the Eastern Capital was building Qianyuan Hall; he again submitted the Eulogy on Qianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Eastern Capital was building Qianyuan Hall; he again submitted the Eulogy on Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 沛王賢聞其名，召為沛府修撰，甚愛重之。

translations.literal: Prince of Pei Xian heard his name and summoned him as Compiler of the Pei establishment; he greatly loved and valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pei Xian heard his name and summoned him as Compiler of the Pei establishment; he greatly loved and valued him.

sentences.zh: 諸王鬥雞，互有勝負，勃戲為《檄英王雞文》。

translations.literal: The princes cock-fought, each having victory and defeat; Bo in jest composed the Proclamation Against the Prince of Ying's Cock.
translations.idiomatic: The princes cock-fought, each having victory and defeat; Bo in jest composed the Proclamation Against the Prince of Ying's Cock.

sentences.zh: 高宗覽之，怒曰：「據此是交構之漸。」

translations.literal: Gaozong read it and angrily said: "From this it is the beginning of mutual incitement."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong read it and angrily said, "From this it is the beginning of mutual incitement."

sentences.zh: 即日斥勃，不令入府。

translations.literal: That same day Bo was expelled and not allowed to enter the establishment.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Bo was expelled and not allowed to enter the establishment.

sentences.zh: 久之，補虢州參軍。

translations.literal: After a long time he was appointed Military Adjutant of Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was appointed Military Adjutant of Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 勃恃才傲物，為同僚所嫉。

translations.literal: Bo relied on talent and was arrogant; colleagues envied him.
translations.idiomatic: Bo relied on talent and was arrogant; colleagues envied him.

sentences.zh: 有官奴曹達犯罪，勃匿之，又懼事泄，乃殺達以塞口。

translations.literal: A government slave Cao Da committed a crime; Bo hid him, then fearing the matter would leak killed Da to stop mouths.
translations.idiomatic: A government slave Cao Da committed a crime; Bo hid him, then fearing the matter would leak killed Da to stop mouths.

sentences.zh: 事發，當誅，會赦除名。

translations.literal: When the matter was exposed he should have been executed; an amnesty arrived and his name was struck.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was exposed he should have been executed; an amnesty arrived and his name was struck.

sentences.zh: 時勃父福畤為雍州司戶參軍，坐勃左遷交趾令。

translations.literal: At the time Bo's father Fuchao was Revenue Clerk of Yong Prefecture; punished because of Bo he was demoted Magistrate of Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Bo's father Fuchao was Revenue Clerk of Yong Prefecture; punished because of Bo he was demoted Magistrate of Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 上元二年，勃往交趾省父，道出江中，為《采蓮賦》以見意，其辭甚美。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shangyuan Bo went to Jiaozhi to visit his father; on the road through the river he composed the Rhapsody on Gathering Lotus to express his intent—the language very beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shangyuan Bo went to Jiaozhi to visit his father; on the road through the river he composed the Rhapsody on Gathering Lotus to express his intent—the language very beautiful.

sentences.zh: 渡南海，墮水而卒，時年二十八。

translations.literal: Crossing the Southern Sea he fell into the water and died, aged twenty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Southern Sea he fell into the water and died, aged twenty-eight.

sentences.zh: 苾，弱冠進士登第，累除太子典膳丞。

translations.literal: Ji, at weak crown passed Jinshi and was repeatedly appointed Director of the Heir Apparent's Commissary for Food.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, at weak crown passed Jinshi and was repeatedly appointed Director of the Heir Apparent's Commissary for Food.

sentences.zh: 長壽中，擢為鳳閣舍人。

translations.literal: In the Changshou era he was promoted Attendant of the Phoenix Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Changshou era he was promoted Attendant of the Phoenix Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 時壽春王成器、衡陽王成義等五王初出閣，同日授冊。

translations.literal: At the time Princes of Shouchun Chengqing, Hengyang Chengyi, and four others first left the palace and on the same day received investiture.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Princes of Shouchun Chengqing, Hengyang Chengyi, and four others first left the palace and on the same day received investiture.

sentences.zh: 有司撰儀註，忘載冊文。

translations.literal: The responsible office drafted ritual notes and forgot to include the investiture texts.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible office drafted ritual notes and forgot to include the investiture texts.

sentences.zh: 及百僚在列，方知闕禮，宰相相顧失色。

translations.literal: When the hundred officials were in ranks they then knew the rite was lacking; the chief ministers looked at one another and changed color.
translations.idiomatic: When the hundred officials were in ranks they then knew the rite was lacking; the chief ministers looked at one another and changed color.

sentences.zh: 苾立召書吏五人，各令執筆，口占分寫，一時俱畢。

translations.literal: Ji immediately summoned five clerks, each ordered to hold brush; he dictated and divided the writing—all finished at once.
translations.idiomatic: Ji immediately summoned five clerks, each ordered to hold brush; he dictated and divided the writing—all finished at once.

sentences.zh: 詞理典贍，人皆嘆服。

translations.literal: Language and principle were canonical and ample; all sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Language and principle were canonical and ample; all sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 尋加弘文館學士，兼知天官侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was added Academic Scholar of the Hongwen Hall and concurrently Acting Vice Director of the Celestial Office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was added Academic Scholar of the Hongwen Hall and concurrently Acting Vice Director of the Celestial Office.

sentences.zh: 苾頗任權勢，交結非類。

translations.literal: Ji quite wielded power and associated with improper sorts.
translations.idiomatic: Ji quite wielded power and associated with improper sorts.

sentences.zh: 萬歲通天二年，綦連耀謀逆事泄，閟坐與耀善，並弟閟並伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wansui Tongtian, Qi Lianyao's plot at treason was exposed; Ji was punished for friendship with Yao, and together with younger brother Bi both were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wansui Tongtian, Qi Lianyao's plot at treason was exposed; Ji was punished for friendship with Yao, and together with younger brother Bi both were executed.

sentences.zh: 閟累官至涇州刺史。

translations.literal: Bi was repeatedly promoted to Prefect of Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bi was repeatedly promoted to Prefect of Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 神龍初，有詔追復苾、閟官位。

translations.literal: In the early Shenlong era an edict restored the official ranks of Ji and Bi.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shenlong era an edict restored the official ranks of Ji and Bi.

sentences.zh: 福畤，天後朝以子貴，累轉澤州長史，卒。

translations.literal: Fuchao, in the Heavenly Empress era because of his son's eminence was repeatedly transferred to Chief Administrator of Ze Prefecture and died.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchao, in the Heavenly Empress era because of his son's eminence was repeatedly transferred to Chief Administrator of Ze Prefecture and died.

sentences.zh: 初，吏部侍郎裴行儉典選，有知人之鑒，見苾與蘇味道，謂人曰：「二子亦當掌銓衡之任。」

translations.literal: Initially Vice Director of Personnel Pei Xingjian managed selection and had the discernment to know men; seeing Ji and Su Weidao he said to people: "These two sons also ought to hold the balance of selection."
translations.idiomatic: Initially Vice Director of Personnel Pei Xingjian managed selection and had the discernment to know men; seeing Ji and Su Weidao he said to people, "These two sons also ought to hold the balance of selection."

sentences.zh: 李敬玄尤重楊炯、盧照鄰、駱賓王與勃等四人，必當顯貴。

translations.literal: Li Jingxuan especially valued Yang Jiong, Lu Zhaolin, Luo Binwang, and Bo and the four men—they would surely reach eminence.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxuan especially valued Yang Jiong, Lu Zhaolin, Luo Binwang, and Bo and the four men—they would surely reach eminence.

sentences.zh: 行儉曰：「士之致遠，先器識而後文藝。

translations.literal: Xingjian said: "For a scholar to reach far, first capacity and discernment, afterward literary art.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjian said, "For a scholar to reach far, first capacity and discernment, afterward literary art.

sentences.zh: 勃等雖有文才，而浮躁淺露，豈享爵祿之器耶！

translations.literal: Bo and the others though having literary talent were yet floating, shallow, and exposed—are they vessels to enjoy rank and salary?
translations.idiomatic: Bo and the others though having literary talent were yet floating, shallow, and exposed—are they vessels to enjoy rank and salary?

sentences.zh: 楊子沈靜，應至令長，余得令終為幸。」

translations.literal: Yang Zi is calm and still—he ought to reach magistrate; for the rest to end as magistrate would be my fortune."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zi is calm and still—he ought to reach magistrate; for the rest to end as magistrate would be my fortune."

sentences.zh: 果如其言。

translations.literal: It turned out as he said.
translations.idiomatic: It turned out as he said.

sentences.zh: 勃文章邁捷，下筆則成，尤好著書。

translations.literal: Bo's writing was surpassingly quick; taking up the brush it was done; he especially loved authorship.
translations.idiomatic: Bo's writing was surpassingly quick; taking up the brush it was done; he especially loved authorship.

sentences.zh: 撰《周易發揮》五卷，及《次論》等書數部。

translations.literal: He compiled Elaboration on the Changes of Zhou in five scrolls, and the Sequential Discourses and other books in several parts.
translations.idiomatic: He compiled Elaboration on the Changes of Zhou in five scrolls, and the Sequential Discourses and other books in several parts.

sentences.zh: 勃亡後，並多遺失。

translations.literal: After Bo's death many were lost.
translations.idiomatic: After Bo's death many were lost.

sentences.zh: 有文集三十卷。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in thirty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He had a collected works in thirty scrolls.

sentences.zh: 勃聰警絕眾，於推步歷算尤精，嘗作《大唐千歲歷》，言唐德靈長千年，不合承周、隋短祚。

translations.literal: Bo was clever and alert beyond the multitude; in calendrical calculation and reckoning he was especially precise; he once composed the Thousand-Year Calendar of the Great Tang, saying Tang's virtue would endure a thousand years and ought not inherit the short reigns of Zhou and Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Bo was clever and alert beyond the multitude; in calendrical calculation and reckoning he was especially precise; he once composed the Thousand-Year Calendar of the Great Tang, saying Tang's virtue would endure a thousand years and ought not inherit the short reigns of Zhou and Sui.

sentences.zh: 其論大旨云：「以土王者，五十代而一千年；

translations.literal: The main argument said: "Those who rule by earth—fifty generations and one thousand years;
translations.idiomatic: The main argument said, "Those who rule by earth—fifty generations and one thousand years;

sentences.zh: 金王者，四十九代而九百年；

translations.literal: those who rule by metal—forty-nine generations and nine hundred years;
translations.idiomatic: those who rule by metal—forty-nine generations and nine hundred years;

sentences.zh: 水王者，二十代而六百年；

translations.literal: those who rule by water—twenty generations and six hundred years;
translations.idiomatic: those who rule by water—twenty generations and six hundred years;

sentences.zh: 木王者，三十代而八百年；

translations.literal: those who rule by wood—thirty generations and eight hundred years;
translations.idiomatic: those who rule by wood—thirty generations and eight hundred years;

sentences.zh: 火王者，二十代而七百年。

translations.literal: those who rule by fire—twenty generations and seven hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: those who rule by fire—twenty generations and seven hundred years.

sentences.zh: 此天地之常期，符歷之數也。

translations.literal: These are heaven and earth's constant periods, the numbers of talisman and calendar.
translations.idiomatic: These are heaven and earth's constant periods, the numbers of talisman and calendar.

sentences.zh: 自黃帝至漢，並是五運真主。

translations.literal: From the Yellow Emperor through Han—all were true lords of the Five Phases.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yellow Emperor through Han—all were true lords of the Five Phases.

sentences.zh: 五行已遍，土運復歸，唐德承之，宜矣！

translations.literal: The Five Phases having run their course, the earth phase returns; Tang virtue inherits it—fitting!
translations.idiomatic: The Five Phases having run their course, the earth phase returns; Tang virtue inherits it—fitting!

sentences.zh: 魏、晉至於周、隋，鹹非正統，五行之沴氣也，故不可承之。」

translations.literal: Wei and Jin down to Zhou and Sui—all were not legitimate succession, the baleful qi of the Five Phases; therefore they cannot be inherited."
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Jin down to Zhou and Sui—all were not legitimate succession, the baleful qi of the Five Phases; therefore they cannot be inherited."

sentences.zh: 大率如此。

translations.literal: The general drift was thus.
translations.idiomatic: The general drift was thus.

sentences.zh: 駱賓王

translations.literal: Luo Binwang
translations.idiomatic: Luo Binwang

sentences.zh: 駱賓王，婺州義烏人。

translations.literal: Luo Binwang was a man of Yiwu in Wu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Binwang was a man of Yiwu in Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少善屬文，尤妙於五言詩，嘗作《帝京篇》，當時以為絕唱。

translations.literal: In youth he was skilled at literary composition, especially marvelous at five-character poetry; he once composed On the Imperial Capital, which contemporaries regarded as a supreme song.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was skilled at literary composition, especially marvelous at five-character poetry; he once composed On the Imperial Capital, which contemporaries regarded as a supreme song.

sentences.zh: 然落魄無行，好與博徒遊。

translations.literal: Yet he was down-and-out without conduct and loved to roam with gamblers.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was down-and-out without conduct and loved to roam with gamblers.

sentences.zh: 高宗末，為長安主簿。

translations.literal: In the late Gaozong era he was Chief Clerk of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the late Gaozong era he was Chief Clerk of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 坐贓，左遷臨海丞，怏怏失誌，棄官而去。

translations.literal: Punished for corruption he was demoted left Chief Clerk of Linhai; resentful and losing ambition he abandoned office and left.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for corruption he was demoted left Chief Clerk of Linhai; resentful and losing ambition he abandoned office and left.

sentences.zh: 文明中，與徐敬業於揚州作亂。

translations.literal: In the Wenming era he with Xu Jingye at Yang Prefecture raised rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wenming era he with Xu Jingye at Yang Prefecture raised rebellion.

sentences.zh: 敬業軍中書檄，皆賓王之詞也。

translations.literal: All proclamations in Jingye's army were Binwang's words.
translations.idiomatic: All proclamations in Jingye's army were Binwang's words.

sentences.zh: 敬業敗，伏誅，文多散失。

translations.literal: Jingye was defeated and executed; much of the writing was scattered and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Jingye was defeated and executed; much of the writing was scattered and lost.

sentences.zh: 則天素重其文，遣使求之。

translations.literal: Zetian had long valued his writing and sent envoys to seek it.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian had long valued his writing and sent envoys to seek it.

sentences.zh: 有兗州人郤雲卿集成十卷，盛傳於世。

translations.literal: A man of Yan Prefecture, Xi Yunqing, assembled ten scrolls, greatly transmitted in the world.
translations.idiomatic: A man of Yan Prefecture, Xi Yunqing, assembled ten scrolls, greatly transmitted in the world.

sentences.zh: 鄧玄挺

translations.literal: Deng Xuanting
translations.idiomatic: Deng Xuanting

sentences.zh: 鄧玄挺，雍州藍田人。

translations.literal: Deng Xuanting was a man of Lantian in Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Xuanting was a man of Lantian in Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少善屬文，累遷左史。

translations.literal: In youth he was skilled at literary composition and was repeatedly promoted to Left Historian.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was skilled at literary composition and was repeatedly promoted to Left Historian.

sentences.zh: 坐與上官儀善，出為頓丘令。

translations.literal: Punished for friendship with Shangguan Yi he was sent out Magistrate of Dunqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for friendship with Shangguan Yi he was sent out Magistrate of Dunqiu.

sentences.zh: 有善政，璽書勞問。

translations.literal: He had good governance; an imperial letter commended and inquired.
translations.idiomatic: He had good governance; an imperial letter commended and inquired.

sentences.zh: 累授中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly appointed Palace Secretary Drafting Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly appointed Palace Secretary Drafting Clerk.

sentences.zh: 性俊辨，機捷過人，每有嘲謔，朝廷稱為口實。

translations.literal: By nature handsome in debate, nimble and surpassing others—whenever there was mockery the court took it as a byword.
translations.idiomatic: By nature handsome in debate, nimble and surpassing others—whenever there was mockery the court took it as a byword.

sentences.zh: 則天臨朝，遷吏部侍郎，既不稱職，甚為時談所鄙。

translations.literal: When Zetian held court she promoted him Vice Director of Personnel; not competent in office, he was greatly despised in contemporary talk.
translations.idiomatic: When Zetian held court she promoted him Vice Director of Personnel; not competent in office, he was greatly despised in contemporary talk.

sentences.zh: 又患消渴之疾，選人目為「鄧渴」，為榜於衢路。

translations.literal: Also suffering from wasting-thirst illness, selectors called him "Deng Thirsty" and posted placards on the public road.
translations.idiomatic: Also suffering from wasting-thirst illness, selectors called him "Deng Thirsty" and posted placards on the public road.

sentences.zh: 自有唐已來，掌選之失，未有如玄挺者。

translations.literal: Since Tang began, failures in managing selection had none like Xuanting.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tang began, failures in managing selection had none like Xuanting.

sentences.zh: 坐此左遷澧州刺史。

translations.literal: On this account he was demoted left Prefect of Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On this account he was demoted left Prefect of Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 在州復以善政聞，遷晉州刺史，召拜麟臺少監，重為天官侍郎，其失又甚於前。

translations.literal: In the prefecture again he was heard for good governance; he was promoted Prefect of Jin and summoned appointed Vice Director of the Lin Terrace, again Vice Director of the Celestial Office—the failures worse than before.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefecture again he was heard for good governance; he was promoted Prefect of Jin and summoned appointed Vice Director of the Lin Terrace, again Vice Director of the Celestial Office—the failures worse than before.

sentences.zh: 玄挺女為道王子諲妻，又與蔣王子煒相善。

translations.literal: Xuanting's daughter was wife to Prince of Dao Li Jin; she was also on good terms with Prince of Jiang Li Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanting's daughter was wife to Prince of Dao Li Jin; she was also on good terms with Prince of Jiang Li Wei.

sentences.zh: 諲謀迎中宗於房陵，以問玄挺。

translations.literal: Jin plotted to welcome Zhongzong from Fangling and asked Xuanting.
translations.idiomatic: Jin plotted to welcome Zhongzong from Fangling and asked Xuanting.

sentences.zh: 煒又嘗謂玄挺曰：「欲作急計如何？」

translations.literal: Wei also once said to Xuanting: "Want to make an urgent plan—how?"
translations.idiomatic: Wei also once said to Xuanting, "Want to make an urgent plan—how?"

sentences.zh: 玄挺雖皆不答，而不以告。

translations.literal: Though Xuanting answered neither, he did not report them.
translations.idiomatic: Though Xuanting answered neither, he did not report them.

sentences.zh: 永昌元年得罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchang he was punished, imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongchang he was punished, imprisoned and died.
